name: GreenThumb Garden Info
description:
This dataset contains records for 635 community gardens, likely in New York City, with 27 fields describing each garden's location, political and administrative districts, operating details, and hours. Each row includes a garden name, street address, borough, ZIP code, latitude and longitude, cross streets, and a multipolygon geometry field for mapping the garden's footprint. Administrative fields cover community board, assembly, congressional, council, state senate, and police precinct districts, plus neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), census tract, and borough-block-lot (BBL) identifiers. A status field and a jurisdiction field describe the garden's current standing and oversight, and a parks ID links records to park system data. Opening hours are broken out by day of week (Monday through Sunday) in separate columns.
